status_summary: Executive Order 14151, signed 2025-01-20, directed agencies to terminate, to the maximum extent allowed by law, DEI, DEIA and environmental justice offices and positions and equity action plans within 60 days. Bloomberg Tax reported on 2025-03-18 that the group being assembled for Treasury's Equity Hub was placed on administrative leave within days of the inauguration. A Federal Register search found the last meeting notice of the Treasury Advisory Committee on Racial Equity dated 2024-08-01 and no later notice, including no termination notice.

timeline.event: Executive Order 14151 directed agency heads to terminate DEI, DEIA and environmental justice offices and positions, equity action plans and DEI performance requirements within sixty days (published 2025-01-29).
Reporting said the group being assembled for Treasury's Equity Hub was placed on administrative leave within days of the January inauguration, in line with the DEI order.
